title: Hauling oneself upright by pulling is a CDC line at about 1 year
summary: Most babies pull up to stand by about 1 year, the US CDC says.
body: The CDC 1-year movement lines include pulls up to stand. Arms haul the body from the floor into an upright posture. That haul is the whole claim. The page groups it with what most babies do by one year. A haul that comes later is not graded here. National lists elsewhere can choose another age.

sources.title: Milestones by 1 Year
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: Movement line: Pulls up to stand.
